_meta.what: Preservation baseline for the subscription-multi-contract-access bugfix (Property 2). Each entry is the literal (status_code, normalized_body) that login()/refresh() returned, plus the token's decoded claims with iat/exp reduced to exp_minus_iat_seconds.
_meta.regenerate: Check out the pre-fix revision of backend/subscription_auth.py, then run python3 -m tests.test_subscription_preservation_properties --record. Do NOT re-record after the fix: Task 10.3 re-asserts these same goldens.
_meta.token_normalization: body.token -> {'claim_keys': [...]}; claims recorded separately with exp_minus_iat_seconds instead of the moving iat/exp pair
_meta.excluded: The three Preservation Exceptions (2.3/1.7, 2.6/1.6, 2.16/1.14) are deliberately absent — they are asserted separately with their intended NEW values. Inputs where the legacy and fixed decisions disagree for any other reason are excluded too; see the module docstring.
